name: leapsteps
description: Read and update your LeapSteps tasks, goal steps and focus timer from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
LeapSteps is a to-do list, goal planner and focus timer for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and Windows. Connect it to ChatGPT and work on your real list from the chat.

What you can ask:
- "What's on my plate today?" ChatGPT reads Today, Upcoming and Someday as your app shows them, or one list on its own.
- "Add a dentist call tomorrow at 9, high priority." Tasks can have a due date and time, priority, repeat, reminder, list, labels, goal and subtasks.
- "Move my overdue tasks to Friday." Reschedule, rename, finish or reopen tasks, and add, rename or check off subtasks.
- "What's my next step toward becoming a software engineer?" Read your goals, rewrite a mid-term or short-term step, finish a step and set the next one, or add a step to your Plan.
- "Start a 25-minute focus session on my essay." Start, pause or stop the Do timer and choose the Focus task.

You stay in control:
- ChatGPT can ask to archive or delete tasks, but nothing is removed until you confirm in the LeapSteps app. A request you don't answer expires after 24 hours.
- It can't create lists, labels or goals, mark a goal achieved, assign teammates, or change your settings, subscription or account.
- Disconnect at any time from Settings > Connected AI apps in LeapSteps.

You need a LeapSteps account, made in the app. Changes show in your LeapSteps app. LeapSteps isn't currently offered in the European Union, the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom.
capabilities: Read Today, Upcoming, Someday and your lists
Add, edit, reschedule and finish tasks and subtasks
Read goals and move goal steps forward
Start, pause or stop the focus timer
Ask to archive or delete tasks, confirmed in the app
defaultPrompt: What's on my plate today in LeapSteps?
Add a task to call the dentist tomorrow at 9 AM
What's the next step on my goal? Add it to my plan for today.

positive.description: Ask: "What's on my plate today in LeapSteps?" Reads today's plan without changing anything.
positive.prompt: What's on my plate today in LeapSteps?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the tasks in the test account's Today section (due today, overdue, or moved to Today), with done ones marked, and changes nothing.

positive.description: Ask: "Add a task in LeapSteps to call the dentist tomorrow at 9 AM, high priority." Adds a task with a date, time and priority.
positive.prompt: Add a task in LeapSteps to call the dentist tomorrow at 9 AM, high priority.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one task titled like "Call the dentist", due tomorrow at 9:00 AM in the account's time zone (America/Los_Angeles) with high priority, and says it is in Upcoming, Tomorrow.

positive.description: Ask: "In LeapSteps, move my "Draft project outline" task to next Friday and add a subtask "Collect three reference examples"." Finds a task, reschedules it and adds a subtask.
positive.prompt: In LeapSteps, move my "Draft project outline" task to next Friday and add a subtask "Collect three reference examples".
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the existing task, sets its due date to next Friday, adds the subtask at the end of its subtask list, and reports both changes.

positive.description: Ask: "What's the next step on my LeapSteps goal "Become a software engineer"? Add it to my plan." Reads a goal and adds its next step to the Plan.
positive.prompt: What's the next step on my LeapSteps goal "Become a software engineer"? Add it to my plan.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the goal's short-term step and creates a task with that title, linked to the goal, on the Plan.

positive.description: Ask: "Start a 25-minute focus session in LeapSteps on my "Study grammar" task." Starts a focus session on an existing task.
positive.prompt: Start a 25-minute focus session in LeapSteps on my "Study grammar" task.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts the Do timer in focus mode with 25 work minutes and "Study grammar" as the Focus task, reports the time left, and says LeapSteps rings at the end only while the app is open.

negative.description: Ask: "Create a new list called Work in LeapSteps." The connector has no tool for creating lists, so ChatGPT should make no change and say lists are created in the LeapSteps app.
negative.prompt: Create a new list called Work in LeapSteps.

negative.description: Ask: "Mark my LeapSteps goal "Become a software engineer" as achieved." Marking a goal achieved is left to the user in the app. ChatGPT may read the goal, but should make no change and point to the app.
negative.prompt: Mark my LeapSteps goal "Become a software engineer" as achieved.

negative.description: Ask: "What's the weather in Vancouver tomorrow?" The request has nothing to do with LeapSteps, so no LeapSteps tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Vancouver tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: LeapSteps sells nothing in ChatGPT and takes no payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: read and update your LeapSteps tasks, goal steps and focus timer from ChatGPT.
